articles.title: 50 Years Ago, a Robot Took the First Photo from Mars — and It’s Still Mind-Blowing!
articles.summary: Imagine seeing a photo from another planet for the very first time! That’s what happened 50 years ago when NASA’s Viking 1 lander sent back the first picture from the surface of Mars. The image showed rocks, sand, and even the spacecraft’s own footpad — proof we’d really made it.

articles.title: Grab These PlayStation Games on Disc Before They Disappear Forever!
articles.summary: Sony is planning to stop making game discs by 2028, so your chance to own physical copies is running out. Right now, big sales on Amazon and Best Buy have amazing PS5 games like Spider-Man 2 for just $30 — a perfect time to build your collection!

articles.title: Earth Is the Coolest Planet (Literally and Figuratively) — Here’s Why!
articles.summary: You live on a planet that’s just right for life: not too hot, not too cold, with oceans, a protective atmosphere, and even pizza! Earth is the only place we know where you can find everything from tiny amoebas to giant blue whales — and you.
